findings.detail: F16 metric is 6.949x, but source financial highlights show 2025 dividends declared of 1.96 per share versus net investment income of 1.79 per share and a 9.48% NII ratio, so the distribution is about 1.10x NII rather than over 1.5x.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate fund-financials review. The filing's financial highlights provide the relevant anchors: 2025 net investment income per share is 1.79, dividends declared are 1.96, and the NII ratio to average net assets is 9.48%. The distribution-to-NII per-share ratio is approximately 1.10, below the 1.5x F16 threshold, while the flagged observed metric is 6.9494527098831025. The raw source therefore grounds an extraction or derived-field error rather than a genuine excessive distribution.
